study.question: Does a visible-cell temporal extreme add predictive utility beyond counts, mean decay, second decay moment and grouped history content, compared with an equally sized deterministic moment-bound replacement? Is any benefit specific to the recent tail?
study.hypothesis: Observation: exclusive_second achieved validation AUC 0.620342615 versus exclusive_square 0.620024658 (delta 0.000317957), but this is single-seed search evidence. Continuous exclusive freshness also exceeded its presence replacement (0.620256605 vs 0.619502308). Recent content trajectories failed to beat incumbent: covariance with attached gradients 0.619757734, detached 0.620170239, detached bypass 0.619754930; factorized bypass 0.619644406 vs shared 0.619715614. Detachment and bypass therefore do not establish useful content-time complementarity. Mechanism hypothesis: moments can obscure isolated recent matched actions; max one-day decay per exclusive match/action cell may recover a useful tail statistic without content gradients or new information access. A model-summary collision is constructible: decay triples [.54,.55,.56] and [.55+a,.55+a,.55-2a], a=.01/sqrt(3), have equal n, mean and second moment, all age buckets 16, but different maxima/minima. With identical static/category/brand/action values they have identical incumbent inputs in exact arithmetic. This demonstrates an information limitation, not local prevalence or predictive utility. The host first-512 snapshot reported 77.35% multi-event among occupied cells and mean visible n=118.12, but n>=3 tail gaps remain unmeasured.

nearest_work.difference: DIN describes target-conditioned weighted embedding sum and deliberately unnormalized attention intensity. The task baseline uses softmax and coarser category/brand/action/time fields; no exact DIN reproduction is claimed. Here attention remains dormant in the match-group ancestor; append fixed cell-wise temporal extrema and compare against redundant moment bounds. Extrema/pooling are conventional; novelty is unverified.

Author README verifies category, brand and behavior type without behavior item identity. Publisher full paper is unavailable; no detailed DMR comparison or reproduction asserted. Work stays inside supplied causal fields.

Exact incumbent source is current candidate.py, confirmed by SHA256. Preserve its full constructor prefix and all pooled/count/mean/second/context components. Append 16 bounded extreme features through a 512-weight zero-initialized projection before the same ReLU. Counterparts expose only functions of existing n/mean/second.

Prior bypass did not improve either content representation AUC and all four were below incumbent. Shared arms exactly replay earlier fits and are not independent repetitions. Abandon content projections and bypass in this proposal; no inference that all content mechanisms fail.

inherited_components: All source components of g0-r0012-exclusive_second, including dormant attention allocation and seeded construction order.
Static field embeddings and four exclusive target-category/brand match-group mean histories.
Four aggregate match counts, 16 action/match counts, 16 mean one-day decays and 16 second moments.
32-wide scalar correction ReLU, RMS-normalized context modulation and shared correction output; unmodified BCE/Adam host recipe.
study.proposed_difference: Four-arm 2x2 factorial: tail direction (recent=max decay versus oldest=min decay) x source (observed versus moment bound). For each of the 16 exclusive match/action cells, d=exp(-max(age,0)/86400), mu=E[d], q=E[d^2], v=max(q-mu^2,0), r=sqrt(max(n-1,0)*v). Redundant upper U=min(1,mu+r), lower L=max(0,mu-r); set all values zero at empty cells. Observed M=max(d), m=min(d). These are finite-support bounds: L<=m<=mu<=M<=U; singleton and two-event cells have matching observed/bound extrema in exact arithmetic. Bound controls contain no new per-cell scalar information beyond inherited n/mu/q, although the changed basis can aid optimization. Each arm appends exactly one 16->32 bias-free projection initialized zero after all incumbent modules; add it to the inherited preactivation. Every arm computes M,m,U,L before selecting one, retaining identical allocated capacity and intended arithmetic. No trainable temporal scale, content branch, attention, auxiliary loss, test access or extra history. No verified priority claim.
predictions: If recent-tail evidence adds utility, recent_observed exceeds recent_bound and incumbent on full validation AUC under the frozen recipe; improvement over bound alone but below incumbent is insufficient for adoption.

If the effect is specifically recent-tail information, the observed-minus-bound AUC contrast is larger for recent than oldest. Benefits for both tails would instead support a broader tail-summary explanation. Absence of that interaction does not refute all extrema utility.

Host label-free diagnostics should show nonzero observed-bound gaps primarily in cells with n>=3; singleton/two-event discrepancies should be limited to floating-point error. Algebraic collision check establishes admissible information loss but not its population rate.

All arms must preserve empty-history zero correction, padding and joint event-permutation invariance; feature values lie in [0,1] and reverse ordering changes no statistic. At initialization all logits must equal the incumbent for identical inherited tensors because the added projection is zero.

Slice review is exploratory: fixed host history-length/hour/action/frequency slices retain sample/positive/negative counts; no new bins fitted on validation. Candidate diagnostics cover only first 512 and cannot establish population subgroup utility.
falsifiers: Recent observed fails to beat both its matched bound and the stronger incumbent: do not claim a useful recent-tail addition for this implementation.
Recent/oldest observed-minus-bound gains are similar or oldest is stronger: do not claim recent-tail specificity.
Observed-bound feature gaps are negligible, or nearly all occupied cells have n<=2: no consequential tail information limitation established locally.

Padding, empty/zero-length handling, finite logits, same-cell extreme identities, initial preservation or source-boundary checks fail: implementation failure, not scientific counterevidence; retain charged failed receipts.
A single seed improvement that disappears on paired repetitions or loses on measured quality-cost comparison remains preliminary and unsuitable as an efficiency claim.
alternative_explanations: Observed and bound features differ in scale, saturation and correlation; equal parameters do not equate effective capacity or optimization.
From-scratch coadaptation and one search seed; post-fit feature removal is sensitivity, not causal predictive attribution.
Many prior validation comparisons; exploratory effects require a frozen paired-seed comparison.
History is truncated to 128; oldest means oldest visible event, not lifetime start. Quantized age embeddings already encode some temporal information.

Bound clipping creates a less useful basis or redundant information than observed extrema even if no useful new conditional signal exists; a positive contrast is controlled support for this replacement, not a universal mechanism theorem.
Older-tail statistics may encode visible-window density/truncation rather than long-term interest.
No local raw data access, no causal snapshot dates and no independent production point-in-time verification; rely on frozen host causal feature contract and explicitly retain its snapshot limitation.
